text: Implemented explicit Fill/Contain viewport-group fitting, compact compiled surface slots, layout-only dirty tracking, and consistent JavaFX, Three drawing/picking and reference raster placement. Verified exact native/candidate file identity; app integration dc95fd1 retains full evidence at docs/verification/surface-packing-evidence.json.gz (SHA256 11c14e021c6de501ea8e044dbe2183a07e9d263c7002e66dc96e4548c0af49dc). Tests: 55 JVM + 55 JS shared, 12 JVM + 12 JS raster, 13 Three JS, 16 JavaFX, 36 independent native projected-pixel checks, and two real MNI app probes. Raster oracle repair specifies an explicit orthographic projection with independent pixel coverage/color instead of a default-camera-dependent image hash. Native files remain uncommitted alongside existing work; exact local cumulative candidate is retained in the app, not published. Browser WebGL visual qualification and further camera fitting are not claimed.
